data.body: Classification: compound bug — 2 independent sub-issues detected: (1) error-sweep.sh auto-creates bug tickets with low threshold (50 occurrences), generating noise tickets; (2) respond-to-pr-comments defer handler creates duplicate tickets when defers are processed concurrently (race condition in consolidation logic). Both are behavioral + llm-behavioral (Pattern 2 involves skill guidance gap). Score: Pattern 1 = behavioral (threshold/script), Pattern 2 = llm-behavioral (SKILL.md + script). Routing to cluster investigation mode with known root causes from audit.
